title: A person who only asked about joining can never be removed from the gym's enquiry list
what: The Enquiries page lets the owner or desk mark someone "Not interested", but there is no way to delete an enquiry. The server refuses to delete any enquiry, so the name, mobile number, question, follow-up notes and reason stay on MettleUp's server and in its backups for as long as the gym uses MettleUp. These people never became members. If one of them asks the gym to erase their details, the gym cannot do it, though the data agreement says the gym handles erase requests. India's data law also asks that details be erased once their purpose (a possible sale) is over.
expected: The gym can delete an enquiry and the server really removes it; old not-interested enquiries are cleared after a set time that the privacy notice states.
who: people who asked a gym about joining, and gym owners
fix_line: Add a delete for an enquiry that really removes it on the server, and a time limit for old not-interested enquiries

items.reason: All 5 listed promises hold in code. P-A7-panel-3-51: the member app reads the challenge board every time the Gym tab opens, so a saved challenge shows at the next open (inside 10 minutes). P-A7-panel-3-53: the machines list is read again every 30 seconds while open (the machine feature is hidden). P-A7-panel-3-58: a column the AI calls not needed is set unticked, and only ticked columns are brought in. P-A7-panel-3-59: a row-number column starts unticked. P-A7-panel-3-60: a ticked column with no name is dropped before saving. No finding.

Notice: the import screen tells the owner what goes to the AI, matching the notice, but names can still go out (FN-L4-panel-logic-1-01, reused). Purpose and deletion: a person who only enquired can never be erased (new 01); a member can only be archived, never erased (FN-L4-panel-auth-data-01, reused). Children: the import and member page take any birthday, so a child can be added (FN-L4-panel-forms-01, reused). Consent at joining not kept on the server is FN-L4-server-database-1-03 (not this area). Breach timing: nothing in these screens; already FN-L4-server-hq-gate-workers-04.

The Help page hosts the MettleUp access card (owner only, online). It says support looks only when the owner lets them and that MettleUp sees only totals, but MettleUp can open the records alone, and direct database looks and backups are not shown (FN-A5-server-database-1-3-01, FN-A3-notes-claude-1-01, FN-L4-server-hq-gate-workers-03, reused). No new finding in these screens.

Enquiries are kept for ever (new 01). "Undo this import" says members and receipts are removed, but the server only marks them deleted and keeps the details (FN-L4-panel-auth-data-02, reused). A diet plan sent to named members can never be deleted (FN-L4-panel-logic-1-02, reused). Measurement delete and photo remove are real deletes on the server, and the member phone drops a deleted gym measurement on its next read.

Outside sends from these screens: the import AI (Google Gemini, then Claude) gets masked samples and is named in the notice, but names can leak (FN-L4-panel-logic-1-01). The Help question goes to the help server; the notice names Claude, and the HQ reply helper also sends it to Google (FN-L4-hq-app-01). The web-page AI chat shown on an enquiry is not in the notice (FN-L4-server-database-3-02). Entry machine punches are not in the notice (FN-L4-panel-pay-machines-02). WhatsApp buttons only open the owner's own WhatsApp with a typed message; MettleUp sends nothing. No analytics, Health Connect, Google Health or Fitbit here.

These screens hold no account delete. Removing a person: the member page offers only archive (FN-L4-panel-auth-data-01); a removed member keeps photo and measurements (FN-L4-panel-shop-01); an enquiry cannot be removed at all (new 01). Rows only marked deleted stay in every nightly backup too. A real delete was not run (live write).
